'''Anselan''' was [[Warder]] to [[Barashelle]]. He was considerably older than her, and stubborn. 

== History ==
Barashelle bonded a Warder while she was still [[Accepted]] so, as punishment, she was forced to pass the Bond to another [[Aes Sedai]] and bond Anselan when she was raised to the shawl.

The story of Barashelle and Anselan is, however, told to most people as a love story in [[The Flame, the Blade and the Heart]], with Barashelle and Anselan being portrayed as heroes and lovers. [[Birgitte]] reveals the truth of the situation to [[Elayne]].
